instruction_addendum: Add a robust cross-source consistency check step to detect and handle direct conflicts between description and supplier_notes within the same listing. When mutually exclusive labels are asserted for the same field (category or primary_use) with credible exact excerpt evidence from both fields, the system must abstain on that entire conflicting field, returning 'unknown' for category or primary_use as applicable, and add a short review reason noting the internal conflict. This abstention applies even if one source fragment is explicitly stronger or more explicit. Leave unaffected fields unchanged. This prevents committing to incorrect labels forced by single-field evidence when direct conflicts exist. Continue to require exact, case-sensitive excerpt citation from source text supporting all asserted labels. Secondary_uses remain empty unless explicitly and independently supported by non-conflicting evidence. This addition refines conflict resolution to explicitly require abstaining on fields with strong internal evidence contradictions, avoiding incorrect inference or guesswork.
